[quote=corzerran;60932571]Cecilia took another bite of her beef stroganoff. [i]Its really good,[/i] she said. [i]it reminds me a little bit of what my mother used to make when I lived in TamelSabet.[/i]

She took another bite of her meal, and a few moments later, leaned forward slightly.

[i]And yours?[/i] She nudged Elenas ankle playfully with her own. [i]Does it taste like palace food?[/i] There was a grin on Cecilias face, and her eyes glimmered under the lights as she watched for Elenas reaction.[/quote]
Elena smiled playfully, blowing a kiss and moving her hand over Cecilias. [i]"Not like palace food. I used to get the chicken at this place a few blocks away from my apartment in Andrudin. Just like home, honestly."[/i]
She chuckled, brushing Cecilia's arm. [i]"Sometimes I miss living a quiet life in the city. There's something to it that you don't get when you're the queen of a nation."[/i]
